description: Create a manufacturing drawing for laser cutting gaskets. Set up three layers: 'STOCK' (White/Black), 'CUT' (Red), and 'ETCH' (Blue). Draw a 200x200mm square on the STOCK layer. Design a single gasket with: Outer Diameter 80mm, Inner Diameter 50mm, and four 6mm bolt holes on a 65mm bolt circle (all on CUT layer). Add text 'G-01' on the ETCH layer. Create 4 copies of this gasket and nest them inside the 200x200mm stock boundary without overlapping. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/gasket_nesting.dxf'.
